name: Māyā — Eye, Veil, Frame, Horizon
description: The authored whole: the eye's constitutive blindside, Śakti's manifesting veil, the frame claiming the horizon, regard and refraction through the Other, the native field with the paśu and toroidal corrections, and recognition returning through the veil.

scenes.name: An eye opens upon a world
scenes.character: Something stands forward; something recedes; a direction from which things appear. The frame gives an edge; the horizon concerns the field within which anything can come forward at all.

entities.name: the eye — its condition already at work in what appears
the blindside — constitutive, more than the anatomical spot

the horizon — the field of coming-forward, changed by walking and reply

text.title: An eye opens upon a world
text.italic: The whole begins with a capacity before any loss: the eye's condition does not arrive as one more face or obstacle — it is already at work in their appearing.

text.body: An eye opens upon a world. Something stands forward; something recedes; a face can be approached, a path followed. There is a direction from which these things appear, even when attention belongs wholly to what appears. The eye's condition does not arrive as one more face or obstacle — it is already at work in their appearing. Turning towards it, every disclosure

occurs through a further situation of seeing — a mirror shows the eye, a diagram its structures, another observer an angle unavailable from here. The blindside is the condition that lets a view have a foreground at all. The frame gives it an edge, exclusion productive; the horizon is the field within which anything can come forward, changed by walking and reply. Finitude gives disclosure its positive capacity.
Occurrences: the standing-forward and its direction (#0); the mirror and diagram disclosures (#0, deepened at #2's crystal); frame vs horizon (#0, usurped at #2).

text.kicker: #1 · Dyczkowski pp.65–81 (source-matched transcript); the quilt's sleeper correction
text.title: The Śaiva genealogy: measure, dream, crystal
text.italic: The veil embodies manifestation's own power — not an alien substance across a finished spectator; the dream carries the same forgetting intimately.

text.body: Anuttara/Paramaśiva names the unobjectifiable ground; Śakti its power of manifestation and self-articulation — prakāśa and vimarśa together as luminosity and reflexive awareness. Māyā brings measure: this appears, that is withheld; the kañcukas give the bounded knower effective terms — kalā, vidyā, rāga, kāla, niyati. Paśu names the bounded position; buddhi determines, ahaṃkāra appropriates, manas coordinates. The veil belongs to manifestation's power — not an alien substance across a finished spectator.

Blue and yellow are known different in one cognition. The dream carries the forgetting: while dreaming, sleep disappears from the experienced situation; waking changes their relation to their condition, not that it never occurred. Taylor's sleeper correction appoints dissociation, tattvic contraction and the slash to one event — no proof the cosmos sleeps. The crystal displays without knowing; the Śaiva mirror also generates its appearances — no machine phenomenality established.
Occurrences: the kañcukas and paśu (#1, returned at #4's correction); the dream's forgotten condition (#1, #2); the crystal's unknowing display (#1, distinct from #2's usurpation).

text.kicker: #2 · the second forgetting; the Simulation concept's disclosure demand
text.title: The frame calls its boundary the horizon
text.italic: Usurpation embodies constitutive limitation become jurisdiction: the operation that made a situation intelligible now judges every subsequent situation — capture begins when results circulate as self-originating authority.

text.body: The second forgetting: a finite measure forgets its finitude. The frame calls its boundary the horizon; what it cannot admit is redescribed as unreal, irrelevant or already explained. Before another person can answer, the frame supplies a role, score or expected motive; their words become further evidence of what the frame knew. x acts as X — the local 1 claiming the 0 on which it depends.

A complex makes the arrest durable: an image attracts investment, investment colours perception, the perception confirms the image; its basin treats its criterion as necessity — the forgotten field holds rejected alternatives, bodily conditions, other lives. The relay: a model describes, action changes the situation, another model receives the changed world. Recurrence is not captivity: capture begins when the result erases its status as result and circulates as self-originating authority.
Occurrences: the usurping criterion and the prepared role (#2); the complex basin (#2, returned at #5→0 via A19); the relay's provenance condition (#2, #5→0 via A31/A32).

text.title: The Other interrupts — regard, context, refraction
text.italic: Regard begins when the excess can alter the measure of the encounter: attention becomes answerable, the criterion questionable by what it concerns.

text.body: The Other interrupts: a reply refuses the role prepared for it; an encounter changes which question deserves to be asked. Regard begins when this excess can alter the measure of the encounter — attention becomes answerable, the criterion questionable by what it concerns. The face-to-face exceeds the image held of the Other; ethical excess is not a stronger quantity on an unchanged scale of power.

Context holds their difference: one view meets a counterview, the 180°→360° turn — another angle discloses an occlusion and carries its own; never an omniscient panorama. The stained window: light through panes, seams marking divisions, projection changing with sun and viewer; Bimba the Original order, QL the immanent spectrum, MEF the refractive operation, pratibimba the situated display. An achieved image can become local Bimba, remaining pratibimba to wider sources.
Occurrences: the interrupting reply (#2, #3); the window's assignments (shared with the stained-glass whole); the local-Bimba office (#3, #5→0).

text.title: Recognition returns through the veil
text.italic: The return keeps the world differentiated and the knower situated: līlā's play has real positions and consequences — the return releases their claim to originate the whole, not the positions themselves.

text.body: The native articulation holds the field: −/−; 0/1; ?/!; −/+; X/x; AM/IS; ∞/dx; returning 1/0 — the six turns renumber nothing. The Neumann appointments carry it (human-amplified: yes). The paśu correction: recognition precedes separation into husband and wife; the bounded position arises within recognition's field and cannot originate it. The toroidal appointment keeps its offices: Anuttara the unobjectifiable opening; Māyā the measure-field wound around it — not the hole.

Recognition returns through the veil: "Līlā veils; hybris absolutises the veil; recognition sees the veil as Śakti." The play keeps positions; the return releases their claim to originate the whole, not the positions. A24: necessary measuring preserved, usurped measure answerable; A19 the complex's changed jurisdiction; A21 resituation without deleting the differentiated life; A27 the Other beyond my image; A35/A36 the completed view returning to the zero it could never occupy.

Declared cross-story: toroidal offices shared with the uroboros whole; the paśu correction shared with the Neumann whole. ↳ Occurrences: the veil and the opening (#1, #4, #5→0); the eye opening again (#0, #5→0).
